             t.cast(str, self.static_folder), filename, max_age=max_age
         )
 
+    def register_blueprint(self, blueprint: Blueprint, **options: t.Any) -> None:
+        """Register a :class:`~flask.Blueprint` on this blueprint.
+
+        Keyword arguments passed to this method will override the
+        defaults set on the blueprint.
+        """
+        if "url_prefix" not in options:
+            if blueprint.url_prefix is not None:
+                options["url_prefix"] = blueprint.url_prefix
+        else:
+            if blueprint.url_prefix is not None:
+                # Normalize slashes and concatenate prefixes
+                parent_prefix = options["url_prefix"].rstrip("/")
+                child_prefix = blueprint.url_prefix.lstrip("/")
+                options["url_prefix"] = f"{parent_prefix}/{child_prefix}"
+
+        self._blueprints.append((blueprint, options))
+
